grpo_paper.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models (Shao, Wang, Zhu, Xu, Song, Bi, Zhang, Zhang, Li, Wu, Guo; DeepSeek-AI)
grpo_paper.text: atlas/papers/grpo/paper.txt (html_to_text.py over the arXiv HTML; MathML replaced by its LaTeX alttext; sha256 in discovered.json)
grpo_paper.anchor_convention: grpo:§4.1.1 (section as printed), grpo:eqN (equation number as printed in the HTML), grpo:table5 / grpo:fig7 / grpo:algorithm1
grpo_paper.note: Fetched 2026-09-30 from the arXiv HTML; no PDF was downloaded, so there are no page anchors. Equation numbers were paired with their LaTeX by discover_paper.py from the printed '(N)' tags (21 equations). Figures 5-7 are images: only captions and the prose around them are quotable. Algorithm 1 line 11 cites 'Equation 21' as printed; in the HTML numbering Eq. 3 is the objective and Eq. 21 its gradient coefficient.

feynrl_repo.title: FeynRL: RL post-training library (local clone), GRPO implementation
feynrl_repo.anchor_convention: algs/GRPO/grpo.py:L169-L176 (repo-relative path, 1-based inclusive line range), algs/RL/common.py:L131-L139, rollouts/base.py:L131-L136
feynrl_repo.note: Code anchors carry status 'implemented': the lines are where this paper's Eq. 3 (ratio/min/clip, beta*KL in the loss), Eq. 4 (k3 estimator) and §4.1.2 (group mean/std) are executed. Divergences from the paper (Bessel-corrected std, kl_coeff 0 in the gsm8k recipe, asymmetric clip bounds, global token normalisation) are listed in discovered.json code.divergences.
